HxC Floppy Emulator 2.16.13.1

Author: Jean-Francois Del Nero / HxC2001 and contributors.
Purpose: ZX Spectrum IPF-to-DSK conversion on Windows.
Project: https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator
Release: https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator/releases/tag/HxCFloppyEmulator_V2_16_13_1

The x64 hxcfe.exe, x64/x86 libhxcfe.dll and libusbhxcfe.dll, and config.script
are unmodified files from the official Windows release archive:
https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator/releases/download/HxCFloppyEmulator_V2_16_13_1/HxCFloppyEmulator_soft.zip
Archive SHA-256: e83e361407893dcdab10cc2e169bf0504dfe3802360a902b01269b4585778091

The x86 hxcfe.exe is rebuilt by OptiMiyoo from the unchanged release source.
The official x86 executable has no relocation table and Windows rejects it
inside AppContainer. This build supplies relocations; conversion still uses
the unchanged official x86 DLLs. It is not an upstream-provided executable.

Source: https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator/tree/0a8f492d9b96e7c35283cf4ddf629c802f63fcf1
The complete source archive is included as HxCFloppyEmulator-source-2.16.13.1.zip:
https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator/archive/0a8f492d9b96e7c35283cf4ddf629c802f63fcf1.zip
Source archive SHA-256: ae75804a55635677eaf0754fc772bdeeaa5703acd0b7c2c04149f6a2c193364f

Reproduce the x86 executable on Windows with the official portable Zig 0.17.0:
https://ziglang.org/download/0.17.0/zig-x86_64-windows-0.17.0.zip
Compiler archive SHA-256: b5663f69581dcf391293fbf16c06cb80d81d806545ce618b4d0bab7f0eb8c428

Extract the source to a short path. In its root, set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1743897600
(2025-04-06 UTC). Set HXC_RUNTIME to OptiMiyoo's app/ZX/tools/hxc/x86 folder.
Run this command with zig.exe on PATH (shown wrapped; join into one line):

zig cc -target x86-windows-gnu -O2 -s -Wno-error=date-time
  -I libhxcfe/sources -I libusbhxcfe/sources -I libhxcadaptor/sources -I build
  -o hxcfe.exe HxCFloppyEmulator_cmdline/sources/hxcfe.c
  HxCFloppyEmulator_cmdline/sources/utils.c libhxcadaptor/sources/libhxcadaptor.c
  libhxcadaptor/sources/fs.c libhxcadaptor/sources/network.c
  libhxcadaptor/sources/cache.c "%HXC_RUNTIME%/libhxcfe.dll"
  "%HXC_RUNTIME%/libusbhxcfe.dll" -lws2_32 -lwinmm

Rebuilt x86 hxcfe.exe SHA-256: 5eb18ce04c9d3d3723bf8177e89d12705bce24e1f17141eb5509c1be4952643e
Two independent source/temp/cache builds produced this same binary.

COPYING and COPYING_FULL retain upstream license and embedded-library notices.
Compiler/runtime notices for this rebuild are in ../nibtools/COPYING.ZIG and
../nibtools/COPYING.MINGW. CAPSIMG and its runtime DLLs are documented separately
in ../capsimg and ../runtime.
